description: Image Description: The image features a close-up view of a black computer mouse resting on a dark, rectangular mouse pad. The mouse is positioned on the left side of the frame and has a glossy surface with a visible scroll wheel and a cord extending from its rear. The mouse pad lies on a flat, light-colored surface, possibly a desk or table, which occupies the lower portion of the image. In the background, there is a blurred cityscape featuring numerous buildings of varying heights and architectural styles.
